title_o: Oxytocin blurs the self-other distinction during trait judgments and reduces medial prefrontal cortex responses

replications.journal: Progress in Neuro-Psychopharmacology and Biological Psychiatry
replications.quote: We confirmed that in the whole sample oxytocin influenced self-other distinction in terms of reduced decision time.
we confirmed that it blurred self-other distinction in terms of decision time and subsequent memory
